source_text: Direct analysis may be substituted for the formulae and values given in this section if they are deemed by the Administration or the classification society to be invalid or inapplicable for a given structural arrangement or detail. Otherwise, direct analysis is not to be used as an alternative to the analytical procedures prescribed by the explicit requirements in sections 4.3 - 4.5.
rationale: Approved direct analysis replaces an inapplicable prescribed procedure and records the structural arrangement.
